# First, go to position 0 (leftmost)
action(['LEFT', 'LEFT', 'LEFT', 'LEFT'])  # Go from pos 4 to pos 0

seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']
white_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['color'] == 'W']
print(f"After 4 LEFTs: white markers at cols {[n['boundary'][0][1] for n in white_nodes]}")

# Record current hashes
def get_strip_hashes():
    sky = []
    pink = []
    for n in nodes:
        if n['color'] == 'B':
            min_row = min(p[0] for p in n['boundary'])
            min_col = min(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
            parent_color = None
            for other in nodes:
                if n['id'] in other.get('children', []):
                    parent_color = other['color']
                    break
            if parent_color == 'S' and min_row >= 40:
                sky.append((min_col, n['hash'][:8]))
            elif parent_color == 'P' and min_row >= 50:
                pink.append((min_col, n['hash'][:8]))
    sky.sort()
    pink.sort()
    return sky, pink

sky_before, pink_before = get_strip_hashes()
print(f"Sky hashes before: {[h for _, h in sky_before]}")
print(f"Pink hashes before: {[h for _, h in pink_before]}")

# Press UP once
action(['UP'])
sky_after, pink_after = get_strip_hashes()
print(f"\nAfter 1 UP:")
print(f"Sky hashes: {[h for _, h in sky_after]}")
print(f"Pink hashes: {[h for _, h in pink_after]}")

# Check what changed
for i, ((c1, h1), (c2, h2)) in enumerate(zip(sky_before, sky_after)):
    if h1 != h2:
        print(f"  Sky pos {i} changed: {h1} -> {h2}")
for i, ((c1, h1), (c2, h2)) in enumerate(zip(pink_before, pink_after)):
    if h1 != h2:
        print(f"  Pink pos {i} changed: {h1} -> {h2}")

# Check white marker position
white_nodes = [n for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'W']
print(f"White markers after UP: cols {[n['boundary'][0][1] for n in white_nodes]}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
